about: The evangelium of the formulary “15th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Jesus was going into a city which is called Nain, and His disciples were going with Him, and a large crowd. And as He was drawing near to the gate of the city, behold, a dead man was being carried out, his mother’s only son, and she was a widow; and a great crowd of the city was with her. When the Lord saw her, moved with compassion for her, He said to her: Do not weep. And He came near and touched the bier; and those who were carrying it stood still. And He said: Young man, I say to you, arise. And he who had been dead sat up and began to speak. And He gave him to his mother. And fear took hold of them all, and they were glorifying God, saying: A great prophet has arisen among us, and God has visited His people.
